priestess of the wild sun soul core

description.value: It is covered with foreign symbols.
The emblem of a dwarven family is engraved on it.
It is pulsating with spectral energy.
The sickle is extremely sharp and feels warm to the touch. This one is quite brittle.
It contains some strange symbols of the lizard language.
It contains a collection of beautiful elven poems.
It is a masterpiece of dwarvish smithery and made of especially hard steel.
It is covered with strange numbers.
It contains the ashes of a lizard high priest.
Rootwalkers can use this to enhance their attire.
